Implementation Plan

## Implementation plan: validation owner routing in the validation run (P1c)

Refs #7913. Local ID `p1c-validate-process-owner-routing`. This covers Phase 1, steps 1 and 5 of `docs/plans/validation-failure-harness-routing-plan.md`.

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-7913` at `05f3bb9decfae1ad9dca0118506054a6fbc4eba9`. The integration branch matches.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends classify-validation-owner
Scope-mode justification: The issue fixes the work exactly. It touches the diagnose prompt trio, routing inside `scripts/validate_process.sh`, one new test file and one appended ci.yml line. Every decision is delegated to P1a's subcommands, which already sit at the integration head: `classify-validation-owner`, `validation-failure-fingerprint`, `error-signature` and `redact-stream` in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py`. Nothing in that file is re-implemented. The validate.yml export and heal-report job (step 6), the intake (step 3), the reporter (step 4), the docs (step 7) and the cycle derivation (Phase 4, near line 209) stay out of scope. One small completeness addition: the owner marker also goes on the Layer 0 harness comments, not only the diagnosis comment. The poller reads the marker by run id, so without it a Layer 0 hold would use a fingerprint that does not match the route marker. That costs about 6 appended suffixes, so it is the complete option under the Boil the Lake rule (§6: correctness ahead of speed).

### Automation / wiring (§20.E)
- **Scripts:** no new script. This extends `scripts/validate_process.sh`, which already runs inside `validate.yml` as the step `Run validation process`, dispatched by the poller and by `/revalidate`. Nothing runs by hand.
- **Scheduler entry point:** unchanged. A later issue (step 6) adds `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HEAL_ENABLED` to the validate step env. Until then the script's own default, `true`, applies (§8).
- **Supervisor:** none needed.
- **Database work:** none.
- **Removal registry:** no entry needed.

## Files likely to change
- `scripts/validate_process.sh`
- `prompts/mode-validate-diagnose.txt`
- `prompts/_templates/mode-validate-diagnose.txt`
- `prompts/contracts/mode-validate-diagnose.yml`
- `tests/test_validate_process_owner_routing.py` (new)
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

## Functions or modules to implement

### 1. Diagnose prompt
These edits are additive and go into both prompt files byte-for-byte, outside the include lines.

- **Schema:**
  - add `"files": ["<consumer-relative path this fix edits>"]` to each `fix_issues` entry;
  - add a top-level `"harness_files": ["<path the harness fix touches>"]` after `"harness_fixes": "string"`.
- **Status semantics**, one bullet each:
  - Both fields are optional. Give `files` only when you know them.
  - `harness_files` lists harness-owned paths, such as `validation/...` or synced wrappers.
  - Omit either field rather than guessing.
  - Older answers without them stay valid.
- **Contract YAML:** `prompts/contracts/mode-validate-diagnose.yml` gets only a `#` comment block naming the two optional output fields. `render_prompt.py` (`CONTRACT_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS`) rejects unknown top-level keys, and its parser skips `#` lines.
- **Unchanged wording:** `"harness_fixes": "string"`, the "fallback" text and every existing line stay as they are.

### 2. `scripts/validate_process.sh`: one delimited helper block
The block is `# BEGIN validation owner routing (project #7913 p1c)` … `# END validation owner routing`. It is inserted right after `write_result_files()` (~2170), so the `fail_*` helpers can call it.

**`validation_owner_enabled`**
- Reads `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HEAL_ENABLED`, defaulting to `true`.
- Unset, empty or `true` (any case) is on, and `false` is off.
- Any other value is off, with one `::warning::` that does not print the value.
- Every helper below returns 0 at once when it is off.

**`validation_owner_helper`**
- Resolves `${VALIDATE_HELPER_STAGE_DIR}/scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py`.
- The file must be a regular file, not a symlink, with a non-empty stage dir.
- It never uses the checkout's `scripts/`.
- On failure it prints nothing and returns 1, which callers treat as fail-open.

**`validation_owner_pipeline_login`**
- Makes one `gh_retry gh api user --jq .login` call.
- Memoized in `${RUNTIME_DIR}/validation_owner_login.txt`, so it survives the self-heal re-exec.
- Regex-checked as `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,38}(\[bot\])?$`.
- Phase 4 can reuse it.

**`validation_owner_load_bounced`**
- Runs only for a tracking run with a resolved login. Memoized as `${RUNTIME_DIR}/validation_harness_bounced_fps.txt`.
- Makes one paginated `gh_retry gh api repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${TRACKING_ISSUE_NUM}/comments --paginate --jq '.[] | select((.body // "") | contains("validation-harness-bounce:v1")) | {login: .user.login, body: .body}'`.
- Filters locally with `jq --arg login`. It keeps `fp` only when the body's last non-blank line matches `^<!-- validation-harness-bounce:v1 fp=([0-9a-f]{64})( [^>]*)? -->$`.
- A §14 comment above the call names the audited existing call (`PRIOR_COMMENTS`, ~3983) and why it is not enough:
  - it keeps bodies only, with no author;
  - it keeps only the last 3 "Runtime validation" comments;
  - it is fetched only when the cycle is above 1.
- A read failure warns, gives an empty list and falls back to today's behaviour.

**`validation_owner_signature <stage> [fallback_text]`** writes `${RUNTIME_DIR}/validation_harness_signature.txt`:
- Log source:
  - `canary`, `run` and `diagnose` use `VALIDATION_LOG_FILE`;
  - `generate` and `preflight` use `GENERATE_LOG_FILE`;
  - `engine` uses `DIAGNOSE_LOG_FILE`, else `GENERATE_LOG_FILE`;
  - `sandbox` uses `VALIDATION_HARNESS_SANDBOX_STATUS_FILE` plus the fallback text.
- The log's last 200 lines go through `redact-stream` and then `error-signature --log-file <tail>`, capped with `cut -c1-200`.
- An empty signature falls back to the compacted fallback text.

**`validation_owner_classify <mode>`** runs `python3 -I -B <helper> classify-validation-owner` with:
- `--consumer-root "$PWD"`
- `--support-root "$VALIDATE_HELPER_STAGE_DIR" --support-commit HEAD`
- `--raw-status`
- `--diagnosis-json "$DIAGNOSE_RESULT_FILE"` (layer1 mode only)
- `--fixed-reason/--fixed-stage "$VALIDATION_HARNESS_REASON"/"$VALIDATION_HARNESS_STAGE"` (fixed mode)
- `--bounced-fingerprints-file`
- `--signature-file`
- `--source-repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"`
- `--managed-paths-file "${VALIDATION_OWNER_MANAGED_PATHS_FILE}"`, only when that new optional variable is set. It defaults to empty, which lets the classifier build the list itself. It exists for tests.

Output and checks:
- The result goes to `${RUNTIME_DIR}/validation_owner.json`.
- Each field is validated:
  - owner ∈ `harness|project|mixed|none`;
  - stage ∈ the 7 `VALIDATION_STAGES`;
  - reason ∈ `VALIDATION_REASONS` plus `bounced_repeat`;
  - fp is `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`;
  - paths are arrays.
- An empty fingerprint with owner harness or mixed and a valid stage and reason calls `validation-failure-fingerprint --stage --reason --signature-file`.
- A non-zero exit, invalid JSON or unknown vocabulary gives owner `none` with a `::warning::VALIDATION_OWNER outcome=fail_open reason=classifier_unavailable`.
- It sets the shell globals `VALIDATION_OWNER_OWNER`, `_REASON`, `_STAGE`, `_FP`, `_HARNESS_PATHS` and `_PROJECT_PATHS` (comma-joined, capped), plus `_REPORT`.
- `_REPORT` is `true` only when the run is a tracking run and either the owner is `harness`, or it is `mixed` with a fingerprint and reason `mixed_harness_part`.
- It logs exactly one line:
  `VALIDATION_OWNER owner=… reason=… stage=… fp=… harness_paths=… project_paths=…`
  Values are sanitized to `[A-Za-z0-9._/,:-]`, and paths are capped at 10.

**`validation_owner_fixed <reason>`**
- Sets `VALIDATION_HARNESS_REASON` and `VALIDATION_HARNESS_STAGE` from a fixed table: `sandbox_unavailable`→`sandbox`, `preflight_failed`→`preflight`, `canary_failed`→`canary`, `generate_failed`→`generate`, `engine_unavailable`→`engine`, `escalated_repeat`→`run`.
- Then runs signature, bounce load and classify in fixed mode.

**`validation_owner_comment_marker`**
- Prints `\n\n<!-- validation-harness-owner:v1 fp=<fp> stage=<stage> reason=<reason> support=<40hex> run=<run_id> -->` with a literal `\n`, which `post_tracking_comment` expands.
- Prints it only when all of these hold: the owner is `harness`; fp, stage and reason are valid; `run` is `GITHUB_RUN_ID` and all digits; `support` is `VALIDATE_SUPPORT_SHA` if it is 40 hex, else `git -C "$VALIDATE_HELPER_STAGE_DIR" rev-parse HEAD` if that is 40 hex.
- Otherwise it prints nothing.
- The format matches the poller's existing parser byte for byte (`orchestrate_poll_process.sh` ~15105, last-line regex).

**`validation_owner_merge_fields`**
- Called inside `write_result_files` after `write_status_file` and `write_metadata_file`, as one inserted line.
- Only when the switch is on, it runs `jq` to add `failure_owner`, `harness_report` (JSON bool), `harness_stage`, `harness_reason` and `harness_fp` to `STATUS_FILE`. It adds the same fields plus `harness_paths` and `project_paths` arrays to `METADATA_FILE`.
- It uses an atomic tmp file and `mv`. Values with no decision become `none`, `false` or `""`.
- `raw_status` and `status` are never changed (§6).

**`validation_owner_ruled_out_block`**
- Runs before the diagnose prompt is assembled.
- Computes candidate fingerprints for the current signature with `validation-failure-fingerprint` for `diagnose:diagnosis_harness`, `diagnose:owner_paths`, `diagnose:mixed_harness_part` and `run:escalated_repeat`.
- When any candidate is in the bounced set, it prints `=== HARNESS RULED OUT ===` with fixed text: "The coding-workflows harness owner already reviewed this failure (fingerprint …) and returned it to this repository. Classify as needs_fixes unless you have new evidence; do not repeat the harness hypothesis."
